Mind if I pick your brain? I enjoy compelling era pieces, though some fantasy or sci-fi is also great. I dislike identity politics and infantilizing exposition. By contrast I enjoy subtle metaphor and stories with nuance.

My favorite films would include Das Boot, I Claudius, and Seventeen Moments of Spring. For something more contemporary, I also enjoyed The Expanse. Any recommendations? Films or series in any language are okay.

c.st: Ask HN: Best value computer science book?
c.x:
…Data-Intensive Applications by Kleppmann - not in your circle of interest necessarily but not in your circle of non-interest either.

- Introduction to the Design & Analysis of Algorithms by Levitin - not very popular but a great book. Interestingly, it groups algorithms around design techniques e.g. decrease-and-conquer, divide-and-conquer, greedy, DP.

- Algorithms by Sedgewick and Wayne - great algorithms book if your main programming language is Java, I keep coming back to…

hn.q: "Introduction to the design & analysis of algorithms"
